hebrewText: וָ/אֵ֖רֶא בַּ/חֲלֹמִ֑/י וְ/הִנֵּ֣ה שֶׁ֣בַע שִׁבֳּלִ֗ים עֹלֹ֛ת בְּ/קָנֶ֥ה אֶחָ֖ד מְלֵאֹ֥ת וְ/טֹבֽוֹת

tokens.bdb: to see, literally or figuratively (in numerous applications, direct and implied, transitive, intransitive and causative)
tokens.kjv: advise self, appear, approve, behold, [idiom] certainly, consider, discern, (make to) enjoy, have experience, gaze, take heed, [idiom] indeed, [idiom] joyfully, lo, look (on, one another, one on another, one upon another, out, up, upon), mark, meet, [idiom] be near, perceive, present, provide, regard, (have) respect, (fore-, cause to, let) see(-r, -m, one another), shew (self), [idiom] sight of others, (e-) spy, stare, [idiom] surely, [idiom] think, view, visions.
tokens.explanation: raah — ver, observar, contemplar, perceber, entender
hinneh — interjeição de atenção: eis, veja, olha!

tokens.bdb: seven (as the sacred full one); also (adverbially) seven times; by implication, a week; by extension, an indefinite number
tokens.ptLiteralWord: seven ; also  seven times; by implication
tokens.enLiteralWord: seven ; also  seven times; by implication
tokens.explanation: seven ; also  seven times; by implication
tokens.explanationEn: seven ; also  seven times; by implication

tokens.bdb: a stream (as flowing); also an ear of grain (as growing out); by analogy, a branch
tokens.kjv: branch, channel, ear (of corn), (water-)flood, Shibboleth. Compare H5451 (סִבֹּלֶת).
tokens.ptLiteralWord: a stream ; also an ear of grain ; by analogy
tokens.enLiteralWord: a stream ; also an ear of grain ; by analogy
tokens.explanation: a stream ; also an ear of grain ; by analogy
tokens.explanationEn: a stream ; also an ear of grain ; by analogy

tokens.bdb: to ascend, intransitively (be high) or actively (mount); used in a great variety of senses, primary and secondary, literal and figurative
tokens.kjv: arise (up), (cause to) ascend up, at once, break (the day) (up), bring (up), (cause to) burn, carry up, cast up, [phrase] shew, climb (up), (cause to, make to) come (up), cut off, dawn, depart, exalt, excel, fall, fetch up, get up, (make to) go (away, up); grow (over) increase, lay, leap, levy, lift (self) up, light, (make) up, [idiom] mention, mount up, offer, make to pay, [phrase] perfect, prefer, put (on), raise, recover, restore, (make to) rise (up), scale, set (up), shoot forth (up), (begin to) spring (up), stir up, take away (up), work.

tokens.bdb: a reed (as erect); by resemblance a rod (especially for measuring), shaft, tube, stem, the radius (of the arm), beam (of a steelyard)
tokens.kjv: balance, bone, branch, calamus, cane, reed, [idiom] spearman, stalk.
tokens.ptLiteralWord: a reed ; by resemblance a rod
tokens.enLiteralWord: a reed ; by resemblance a rod
tokens.explanation: a reed ; by resemblance a rod
tokens.explanationEn: a reed ; by resemblance a rod

tokens.bdb: properly, united, i.e. one; or (as an ordinal) first
tokens.kjv: a, alike, alone, altogether, and, any(-thing), apiece, a certain, (dai-) ly, each (one), [phrase] eleven, every, few, first, [phrase] highway, a man, once, one, only, other, some, together,
tokens.explanation: echad — um, unido, o primeiro (numeral ordinal)

tokens.bdb: full (literally or figuratively) or filling (literally); also (concretely) fulness; adverbially, fully
tokens.kjv: [idiom] she that was with child, fill(-ed, -ed with), full(-ly), multitude, as is worth.
tokens.ptLiteralWord: full  or filling ; also  fulness; adverbially
tokens.enLiteralWord: full  or filling ; also  fulness; adverbially
tokens.explanation: full  or filling ; also  fulness; adverbially
tokens.explanationEn: full  or filling ; also  fulness; adverbially

tokens.bdb: good (as an adjective) in the widest sense; used likewise as a noun, both in the masculine and the feminine, the singular and the plural (good, a good or good thing, a good man or woman; the good, goods or good things, good men or women), also as an adverb (well)
tokens.kjv: beautiful, best, better, bountiful, cheerful, at ease, [idiom] fair (word), (be in) favour, fine, glad, good (deed, -lier, -liest, -ly, -ness, -s), graciously, joyful, kindly, kindness, liketh (best), loving, merry, [idiom] most, pleasant, [phrase] pleaseth, pleasure, precious, prosperity, ready, sweet, wealth, welfare, (be) well(-favoured).
tokens.enLiteralWord: good  in the widest sense; used likewise as a noun
tokens.explanation: tov — bom, correto, agradável, útil, virtuoso
tokens.explanationEn: good  in the widest sense; used likewise as a noun
